a2a2a_message.action_requested: API Gateway Expansion — Add 4 Missing Endpoints to Existing TS/Express Gateway

context.goal:
The existing API Gateway at services/api-gateway/ is a TypeScript/Express service (NOT Python as the refactor plan assumed). It currently has:
  - routes/ghostclaw-routes.ts (agents, task-queue, agent-runs, ghostclaw/run, /health)
  - controllers/ghostclaw-controllers.ts
  - middleware/ghostclaw-middleware.ts
  - contracts/ghostclaw-api.yaml

Missing endpoints that MUST be added as new TS route files:
  1. GET  /ready           — Readiness probe (checks DB connection, OmniRoute reachability, queue health)
  2. POST /api/a2a/dispatch — Accept A2A task packets, validate schema, write to _A2A_QUEUE/inbox/
  3. GET  /api/agents/status — Return status of all agents (scan _A2A_QUEUE/assigned/{claude,codex,opencode}/ for active packets)
  4. POST /api/deploy/trigger — Deployment trigger (DRY-RUN ONLY: log intent, require approval token, do NOT execute deploy)

verified_state.note: task_003 was placed in done/ but endpoints were never created. REBIRTH task.

constraints: /api/deploy/trigger MUST be dry-run only (log intent, return 202, do NOT execute)
/api/a2a/dispatch MUST validate packet schema before writing to inbox
/ready MUST check real dependencies (OmniRoute health, queue directory writability)
deliverables: 4 new route files following existing Express Router pattern
4 new controller files with proper TypeScript types
Router registration in a new index.ts or gateway entry point
Schema validation for A2A dispatch packets (validate a2a2a_message structure)

tier_rationale: Tier B: Adds new files alongside existing TS gateway. Does not modify existing routes/controllers. Deploy endpoint is dry-run only. Moderate complexity due to Express pattern matching.
